heading: A brighter dark mode and more terminal fonts
summary: This update brings build details, update controls, and license notices together in Preferences.
changes: Open Preferences → About to see the running version and build, macOS version, last update check, automatic installation settings, and license notices.
Choose a font installed on your Mac
In Preferences → Terminal, pick System Monospace, select an installed font family, or enter a custom family. Save to apply the font to open terminals.
Preferences, the sidebar, and terminals use lighter dark backgrounds. The initial General tab no longer gets a forced focus ring.
notice: Close active SSH, SFTP, and local shell sessions before installing. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
